design_status: Declared before execution of these new experiments, informed by all published R19 results; not externally preregistered.

models: mean of all eight frozen tanh-gradient prices
mean of all eight frozen RBF-direct prices
validation.training: none; R16 frozen models are inputs
validation.comparator: reoptimized accepted time-only amendments, with identical adjustment at each depth and service; outside tier heterogeneity remains
validation.selection: No selection on new observations; both deterministic ensembles reported.
validation.benchmark_gate: For economic validation, the larger exactly evaluated gain of the response and feasible time-only amendment is deployed. The time-only solve is charged and not part of the speed claim.
validation.state_isolation: All numerical workspaces reset per policy/context; no previous-context warm starts in statistical validation.
validation.amendment: Fresh seeds after code inspection identified stateful pilot workspaces. See audit_notes/STATE_ISOLATION_CORRECTION.json; no model changes or selection.

learned_extension.model_parameters: same fixed 192 random tanh features and ridge 1e-7; cubic RBF smoothing 1e-7
learned_extension.rationale: Evaluate learned and classical pipelines across the full model sizes, not only classical solver scaling.
learned_extension.finalization_note: Uniform 64-label budget finalized after dense-label engineering showed large offline cost, before the reported scaling run. No held-out model selection; all configurations and both architectures retained. The original 128-label engineering plan is not described as completed.
learned_extension.label_backend: Lifted full-objective QP, initial eps 1e-9, independent gap <=1e-5
